Here are some catchy Facebook ad headlines for your flooring business:

**Urgency/Limited Time:**
- "Flash Sale: 40% Off All Hardwood - This Weekend Only!"
- "Last 3 Days! Free Installation on Orders Over $1,500"
- "Spring Flooring Sale Ends Soon - Save Up to $2,000!"

**Problem-Solving:**
- "Tired of Hiding Your Ugly Floors? Transform Them in 48 Hours!"
- "Pet Destroyed Your Floors? We Have the Perfect Solution"
- "Still Living with 90s Flooring? Time for an Upgrade!"

**Value-Focused:**
- "Get Luxury Vinyl That Looks Like Real Wood - Half the Price!"
- "Why Pay More? Premium Flooring Starting at Just $2.99/sq ft"
- "Free Room of Carpet with Every Whole-House Installation!"

**Emotional/Lifestyle:**
- "Fall in Love with Your Home Again - New Floors Change Everything"
- "The Floors Your Neighbors Will Envy Are Just One Click Away"
- "Walk on Clouds - Experience Our Ultra-Soft Carpet Collection"

**Direct & Clear:**
- "Waterproof Flooring Experts - Get Your Free Quote Today"
- "5-Star Rated Flooring Installer - 100% Satisfaction Guaranteed"
- "Professional Flooring Installation - Done Right, On Time, On Budget"

**Curiosity-Driven:**
- "This One Flooring Mistake Costs Homeowners Thousands..."
- "The Secret to Floors That Last 25+ Years? It's Not What You Think"
- "See Why 2,000+ Homeowners Chose Us for Their Dream Floors"

Choose headlines that match your current promotions and target audience. Test 3-4 variations to see which performs best!
